newsletter.title: One source and several useful formats
newsletter.body:
Synthetic practice example. All event details below are fictional.

A useful content workflow starts with a clear source. Before choosing a format, choose one idea worth explaining and check the facts that support it. Names, dates, times, and amounts should stay consistent as the content changes shape.

Bright Harbor Lab's fictional workshop explores this process online on 15 October 2026 at 16:00 UTC. The session lasts 60 minutes, and participants need no coding experience.

The exercise begins with source notes, which become a newsletter. That newsletter is then adapted into social posts and a short text-led video. A human reviews the content package before publication. The aim of this exercise is to practice the process, rather than add unsupported claims to make the content sound more impressive.

For the practice package, keep the original source close at hand. If a detail is missing, leave it out or flag it for review. This source does not provide a registration link or price.

Read the practice newsletter.
